literal_meaning: বিড়ালের আরামের সময় উৎপন্ন হওয়া ধ্বন্যাত্মক শব্দ (পুনরাবৃত্তিমূলক)
figurative_meaning_en: An onomatopoeic reduplicated word indicating comfort or contentment
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সোফায় বসে গরগর করে আরাম করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The cat is purring after receiving affection.
He is purring with contentment while lounging on the sofa.
note: This is primarily an onomatopoeic expression used idiomatically to denote satisfaction, common in Bengali folklore and everyday speech involving animals.
